subject: AWS co-sell: ACE intake & PDM/PSM handshake for Acme Health opportunity
messages:
From: Sasha Thompson <sasha.thompson@amazon.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: aws-ace@amazon.com
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: ACE intake for Acme Health (potential co-sell)

Hi Vivek,

Nice to meet you — I'm Sasha on the AWS ACE team covering healthcare accounts in the NW. We have an inbound opportunity with Acme Health that looks like a great fit for AWS co-sell. Quick summary: Acme is evaluating an LLM inference platform for patient data transformation and de-identification workflows (pilot ~Q4). They have expressed interest in a dedicated offering with strong SOC2 controls.

Next steps from AWS side: register this opportunity in ACE + connect Redwood PDM/PSM so we can complete the ACE eligibility checklist. Can you share the best PDM/PSM contacts on your side and confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- ACE eligibility form (signed)
- high-level architecture diagram for private deployment
- an initial mutual action plan (MAP)

I can hold a 30 minute sync next week with Acme (Nina) and your team to align scope and timelines. Proposed windows: Tue 9/8 10–11am PT or Wed 9/9 1–2pm PT.

Thanks,
Sasha

Sasha Thompson
Partner Development Manager, AWS ACE
aws-ace@amazon.com

Attachments: ACE_Eligibility_Template.pdf (stub)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Sasha Thompson <sasha.thompson@amazon.com>, aws-ace@amazon.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: ACE intake for Acme Health (potential co-sell)

Thanks for the intro, Sasha — appreciate the context.

Marissa (Head of PDM Partnerships) and Karthik (Solutions Lead) are looped in. Marissa, Karthik: Acme Health is evaluating a private/dedicated deployment for de-identification pipelines; they require SOC2 evidence and a co-sell path via ACE. Sasha has offered to register the deal on ACE.

Confirming we can provide the ACE eligibility form (see attached) and a short MAP. Karthik can share a 1-page architecture diagram tailored to Acme's requirements.

For the sync, Vivek is +1 for Tue 9/8 10am PT. If that works for everyone, Marissa can join for the PDM conversation and Karthik will cover deployment/infra details.

Action items:
- Marissa: review ACE checklist and flag any gaps (Marissa, can you confirm by EOD Mon?)
- Karthik: prepare a 1-page diagram + list of SOC2 artifacts we can surface
- Sasha: please register ACE and share the registration link/ID when available

Best,
Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: ACE_Eligibility_Form.pdf (filled)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, Sasha Thompson <sasha.thompson@amazon.com>, aws-ace@amazon.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: ACE intake for Acme Health (potential co-sell)

Thanks Vivek and Sasha — looping in Neha from Solutions Engineering for the SOC2/artifacts thread.

I reviewed the ACE template Vivek attached and filled in the initial eligibility responses — see ACE_Eligibility_Form.pdf (attached). I've also drafted a Mutual Action Plan (Redwood-MAP-v1.2.xlsx) that maps milestones to owners and target dates. High level notes:
- Scope: pilot (de-id + batch inference) -> Q4 pilot; production roll targeted Q1.
- Compliance: we can provide SOC2 Type II report, system architecture diagram, and a summary of data handling processes (Neha will assemble).
- Commercial: proposed pilot credits + standard co-sell split per ACE guidelines — we can discuss specifics on the call.

Proposal: 30 min call to align on ACE registration fields + confirm MAP owners. Vivek suggested Tue 9/8 10am PT — that works for me. Sasha, if you can register ACE today and send the link we can attach the documents ahead of the call.

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships (PDM), Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: ACE_Eligibility_Form.pdf, Redwood-MAP-v1.2.xlsx
From: Nina Patel <nina@acmehealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sasha Thompson <sasha.thompson@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: ACE intake for Acme Health (potential co-sell)

Hi all,

Thanks for coordinating. 9/8 10am PT works for our team — I'll be on the call along with our Head of Data Ops (Rahul) and Security lead (Lena). We appreciate you sharing the checklist and MAP in advance; that will help us confirm internal procurement and security requirements.

A couple of quick asks before the call:
- Can Redwood confirm expected SLA targets for the dedicated deployment (99.9% uptime target, typical 95th percentile latency for 2k token inference)?
- Can you include a sample redline for the data processing addendum we should expect to sign?

Look forward to the call.

Best,
Nina
VP, Engineering 
Acme Health

--
